finding: When an entire age band is held out (a genuinely unseen demographic slice, not a random split), the model still reaches 0.58-0.61. The drop from 0.646 is only about 0.05. This shows the headline number is not a random-split artefact.
significance: This is the strongest robustness check in the whole program: the claim survives a deployment-like distribution shift.
note: 36+ band had fewer than 25 subjects and was excluded.
